scientific_decision.headline: target_dependent_or_pareto_tradeoff
scientific_decision.whole_ladder_estimand: Normalized trapezoidal area over rungs 1-8, computed within each training seed; future-source area uses its seven finite rungs.

claim_rule: Treat any design as a universal winner only if the same arm leads the mean endpoint and whole-ladder area on both fixed panels by at least 0.001 ROC-AUC and no alternative beats it by that margin in all three seeds at either endpoint; its worst target must also avoid a mean regression greater than 0.001 against the matched baseline. Otherwise report a target-dependent or Pareto tradeoff.
